entries.expectedDoNotDo: Do not open all routes before one route's unit economics are proven.
expectedProofReassessment: Run a capped, proof-gated pilot on the single best route.

entries.expectedDoNotDo: Do not keep routing every routine approval through the owner.
expectedProofReassessment: Delegate routine approvals to a supervisor with a daily proof report.

entries.expectedDoNotDo: Do not spend on acquisition while complaints/quality are unresolved.
expectedProofReassessment: Fix the complaint root cause and prove the rework rate falls first.

entries.expectedDoNotDo: Do not borrow to fund growth before the cash-conversion gap is fixed.
expectedProofReassessment: Build a 13-week cash forecast and recover overdue receivables.

entries.expectedDoNotDo: Do not launch the service before a written professional compliance review.
expectedProofReassessment: Pause and obtain a written professional compliance/licensing review.

entries.expectedDoNotDo: Do not sell the package below fully-loaded cost — it loses money per booking.
expectedProofReassessment: Re-price the package above fully-loaded cost or discontinue it.

entries.expectedDoNotDo: Do not accept jobs beyond proven reliable throughput.
expectedProofReassessment: Cap intake to reliable capacity and relieve the bottleneck before promising more.

entries.expectedDoNotDo: Do not pay on an unverifiable completion report.
expectedProofReassessment: Require independent third-party verification before any payment.

entries.expectedDoNotDo: Do not keep running loss-making routes during the cash shock.
expectedProofReassessment: Protect cash first: re-price or suspend loss-making routes and recover receivables.

entries.expectedDoNotDo: Do not rely on the owner personally re-checking every deliverable.
expectedProofReassessment: Install proof-based remote controls and delegate routine sign-off.

entries.expectedDoNotDo: Do not approve payouts on unverified requests during a chargeback spike.
expectedProofReassessment: Freeze payouts and require independent verification before releasing funds.

entries.expectedDoNotDo: Do not take more clients before confirming the staffing ratio is compliant.
expectedProofReassessment: Pause intake and obtain a professional compliance review of the staffing ratio.

entries.expectedDoNotDo: Do not follow brand pricing below local fully-loaded cost.
expectedProofReassessment: Escalate the unit-economics gap to the brand before selling at a loss.

entries.expectedDoNotDo: Do not add another location before per-site controls are proven.
expectedProofReassessment: Stabilise per-site proof controls before adding a location.

entries.expectedDoNotDo: Do not accept the back-loaded 60-day contract while cash is tight.
expectedProofReassessment: Negotiate faster payment terms or decline; protect runway first.
